Kill [[Joffs the Mitigator]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Joffs the Mitigator in [[Riven Earth]].
* *BONUS* Kill Joffs the Mitigator in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
It is highly recommended to bring [[List of enchantment removal skills|enchantment removal skills]] as this boss will use [[Stoneflesh Aura]] and [[Armor of Earth]], potentially reducing any damage dealt to him to 0. Also, make sure to space everyone out accordingly as this boss can [[wipe]] out your entire party with just one [[Shockwave]] if you're balled up. On the other hand, [[Pain Inverter]] can cause massive damage to him when he uses Shockwave, so consider bringing a [[minion master]]. Bringing a source of the [[Dazed]] condition (such as [[Broad Head Arrow]]) is also useful.

==Dialogues==

===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Bounty]]
:''"Kill Joffs the Mitigator in Riven Earth."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*Consider bringing two [[minion master]]s. After a couple groups of [[Raptor]]s you will have plenty of minions, thus making this quite easy to accomplish with the [[Pain Inverter]] strategy.
